verses.original: וֶאֱלִישָׁ֡ע דִּבֶּ֣ר אֶל־ הָאִשָּׁה֩ אֲשֶׁר־ הֶחֱיָ֨ה אֶת־ בְּנָ֜הּ לֵאמֹ֗ר ק֤וּמִי וּלְכִי֙ אַתִּי וּבֵיתֵ֔ךְ וְג֖וּרִי בַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר תָּג֑וּרִי כִּֽי־ קָרָ֤א יְהוָה֙ לָֽרָעָ֔ב וְגַם־ בָּ֥א אֶל־ הָאָ֖רֶץ שֶׁ֥בַע שָׁנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: we·’ĕ·lî·šā‘ dib·ber ’el- hā·’iš·šāh ’ă·šer- he·ḥĕ·yāh ’eṯ- bə·nāh lê·mōr qū·mî ū·lə·ḵî ʾat·tī ū·ḇê·ṯêḵ wə·ḡū·rî ba·’ă·šer tā·ḡū·rî kî- qā·rā Yah·weh lā·rā·‘āḇ wə·ḡam- bā ’el- hā·’ā·reṣ še·ḇa‘ šā·nîm
verses.literal: Now Elisha had said to the woman whose son . . . he had restored to life Arise you and your household go and live as a foreigner wherever you can For the LORD has decreed that a seven-year . . . famine will come to the land
verses.literalPt: E FALOU Eliseu àquela mulher cujo filho ele ressuscitara, dizendo: Levanta-te e vai, tu e a tua família, e peregrina onde puderes peregrinar; porque o SENHOR chamou a fome, a qual também virá à terra por sete anos.

verses.original: וַתָּ֙קָם֙ הָֽאִשָּׁ֔ה וַתַּ֕עַשׂ כִּדְבַ֖ר אִ֣ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וַתֵּ֤לֶךְ הִיא֙ וּבֵיתָ֔הּ וַתָּ֥גָר בְּאֶֽרֶץ־ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים שֶׁ֥בַע שָׁנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tā·qām hā·’iš·šāh wat·ta·‘aś kiḏ·ḇar ’îš hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm wat·tê·leḵ hî ū·ḇê·ṯāh wat·tā·ḡār bə·’e·reṣ- pə·liš·tîm še·ḇa‘ šā·nîm
verses.literal: So the woman had proceeded to do as the man of God . . . had instructed And she and her household lived as foreigners for seven years in the land of the Philistines
verses.literalPt: E levantou-se a mulher, e fez conforme a palavra do homem de Deus; porque foi ela com a sua família, e peregrinou na terra dos filisteus sete anos.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י מִקְצֵה֙ שֶׁ֣בַע שָׁנִ֔ים וַתָּ֥שָׁב הָאִשָּׁ֖ה מֵאֶ֣רֶץ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וַתֵּצֵא֙ לִצְעֹ֣ק אֶל־ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ אֶל־ בֵּיתָ֖הּ וְאֶל־ שָׂדָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî miq·ṣêh še·ḇa‘ šā·nîm wat·tā·šāḇ hā·’iš·šāh mê·’e·reṣ pə·liš·tîm wat·tê·ṣê liṣ·‘ōq ’el- ham·me·leḵ ’el- bê·ṯāh wə·’el- śā·ḏāh
verses.literal: At the end of seven years when the woman returned from the land of the Philistines she went to the king to appeal for her house and her land
verses.literalPt: E sucedeu que, ao fim dos sete anos, a mulher voltou da terra dos filisteus, e saiu a clamar ao rei pela sua casa e pelas suas terras.

verses.original: וְהַמֶּ֗לֶךְ מְדַבֵּר֙ אֶל־ גֵּ֣חֲזִ֔י נַ֥עַר אִישׁ־ הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים לֵאמֹ֑ר סַפְּרָה־ נָּ֣א לִ֔י אֵ֥ת כָּל־ הַגְּדֹל֖וֹת אֲשֶׁר־ עָשָׂ֥ה אֱלִישָֽׁע׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ham·me·leḵ mə·ḏab·bêr ’el- gê·ḥă·zî na·‘ar ’îš- hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm lê·mōr sap·pə·rāh- nā lî ’êṯ kāl- hag·gə·ḏō·lō·wṯ ’ă·šer- ‘ā·śāh ’ĕ·lî·šā‘
verses.literal: Now the king had been speaking to Gehazi the servant of the man of God saying Please relate to me all the great things Elisha has done
verses.literalPt: Ora o rei falava a Geazi, servo do homem de Deus, dizendo: Conta-me, peço-te, todas as grandes obras que Eliseu tem feito.

verses.original: וַ֠יְהִי ה֥וּא מְסַפֵּ֣ר לַמֶּלֶךְ֮ אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁר־ הֶחֱיָ֣ה אֶת־ הַמֵּת֒ וְהִנֵּ֨ה הָאִשָּׁ֜ה אֲשֶׁר־ הֶחֱיָ֤ה אֶת־ בְּנָהּ֙ צֹעֶ֣קֶת אֶל־ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ עַל־ בֵּיתָ֖הּ וְעַל־ שָׂדָ֑הּ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר גֵּֽחֲזִי֙ אֲדֹנִ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ זֹ֚את הָֽאִשָּׁ֔ה וְזֶה־ בְּנָ֖הּ אֲשֶׁר־ הֶחֱיָ֥ה אֱלִישָֽׁע׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî hū mə·sap·pêr lam·me·leḵ ’êṯ ’ă·šer- he·ḥĕ·yāh ’eṯ- ham·mêṯ wə·hin·nêh hā·’iš·šāh ’ă·šer- he·ḥĕ·yāh ’eṯ- bə·nāh ṣō·‘e·qeṯ ’el- ham·me·leḵ ‘al- bê·ṯāh wə·‘al- śā·ḏāh way·yō·mer gê·ḥă·zî ’ă·ḏō·nî ham·me·leḵ zōṯ hā·’iš·šāh wə·zeh- bə·nāh ’ă·šer- he·ḥĕ·yāh ’ĕ·lî·šā‘
verses.literal: And Gehazi was telling the king how Elisha had brought the dead back to life Just then the woman whose son Elisha had revived came to appeal to the king for her house and her land So Gehazi said My lord the king this is the woman and this is the son Elisha restored to life
verses.literalPt: E sucedeu que, contando ele ao rei como ressuscitara a um morto, eis que a mulher cujo filho ressuscitara clamou ao rei pela sua casa e pelas suas terras. Então disse Geazi: Ó rei meu senhor, esta é a mulher, e este o seu filho a quem Eliseu ressuscitou.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁאַ֥ל הַמֶּ֛לֶךְ לָאִשָּׁ֖ה וַתְּסַפֶּר־ ל֑וֹ וַיִּתֶּן־ לָ֣הּ הַמֶּלֶךְ֩ סָרִ֨יס אֶחָ֜ד לֵאמֹ֗ר הָשֵׁ֤יב אֶת־ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁר־ לָהּ֙ וְאֵת֙ כָּל־ תְּבוּאֹ֣ת הַשָּׂדֶ֔ה מִיּ֛וֹם עָזְבָ֥ה אֶת־ הָאָ֖רֶץ וְעַד־ עָֽתָּה׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·’al ham·me·leḵ lā·’iš·šāh wat·tə·sap·per- lōw way·yit·ten- lāh ham·me·leḵ sā·rîs ’e·ḥāḏ lê·mōr hā·šêḇ ’eṯ- kāl- ’ă·šer- lāh wə·’êṯ kāl- tə·ḇū·’ōṯ haś·śā·ḏeh mî·yō·wm ‘ā·zə·ḇāh ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ wə·‘aḏ- ‘āt·tāh
verses.literal: When the king asked the woman she confirmed it So the king appointed for her an officer saying Restore all that was hers along with all the proceeds of the field from the day that she left the country until now
verses.literalPt: E o rei perguntou à mulher, e ela lho contou. Então o rei lhe deu um oficial, dizendo: Faze-lhe restituir tudo quanto era seu, e todas as rendas das terras desde o dia em que deixou a terra até agora.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֤א אֱלִישָׁע֙ דַּמֶּ֔שֶׂק וּבֶן־ הֲדַ֥ד מֶֽלֶךְ־ אֲרָ֖ם חֹלֶ֑ה וַיֻּגַּד־ ל֣וֹ לֵאמֹ֔ר בָּ֛א אִ֥ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים עַד־ הֵֽנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō ’ĕ·lî·šā‘ dam·me·śeq ū·ḇen- hă·ḏaḏ me·leḵ- ’ă·rām ḥō·leh way·yug·gaḏ- lōw lê·mōr bā ’îš hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ‘aḏ- hên·nāh
verses.literal: Then Elisha came to Damascus while Ben-hadad king of Aram was sick and the king was told The man of God . . . has come here
verses.literalPt: Depois veio Eliseu a Damasco, estando Ben-Hadade, rei da Síria, doente; e lho anunciaram, dizendo: O homem de Deus é chegado aqui.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ אֶל־ חֲזָהאֵ֗ל קַ֤ח בְּיָֽדְךָ֙ מִנְחָ֔ה וְלֵ֕ךְ לִקְרַ֖את אִ֣ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְדָרַשְׁתָּ֨ אֶת־ יְהוָ֤ה מֵֽאוֹתוֹ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר הַאֶחְיֶ֖ה מֵחֳלִ֥י זֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ham·me·leḵ ’el- ḥă·zā·h·’êl qaḥ bə·yā·ḏə·ḵā min·ḥāh wə·lêḵ liq·raṯ ’îš hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·ḏā·raš·tā ’eṯ- Yah·weh mê·’ō·w·ṯōw lê·mōr ha·’eḥ·yeh mê·ḥo·lî zeh
verses.literal: So the king said to Hazael Take a gift in your hand go to meet the man of God and inquire of the LORD through him Will I recover from this illness
verses.literalPt: Então o rei disse a Hazael: Toma um presente na tua mão, e vai a encontrar-te com o homem de Deus; e pergunta por ele ao SENHOR, dizendo: Hei de sarar desta doença?

verses.original: וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ חֲזָאֵל֮ לִקְרָאתוֹ֒ וַיִּקַּ֨ח מִנְחָ֤ה בְיָדוֹ֙ וְכָל־ ט֣וּב דַּמֶּ֔שֶׂק מַשָּׂ֖א אַרְבָּעִ֣ים גָּמָ֑ל וַיָּבֹא֙ וַיַּעֲמֹ֣ד לְפָנָ֔יו וַיֹּ֗אמֶר בִּנְךָ֨ בֶן־ הֲדַ֤ד מֶֽלֶךְ־ אֲרָם֙ שְׁלָחַ֤נִי אֵלֶ֙יךָ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר הַאֶחְיֶ֖ה מֵחֳלִ֥י זֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·leḵ ḥă·zā·’êl liq·rā·ṯōw way·yiq·qaḥ min·ḥāh ḇə·yā·ḏōw wə·ḵāl ṭūḇ dam·me·śeq maś·śā ’ar·bā·‘îm gā·māl way·yā·ḇō way·ya·‘ă·mōḏ lə·p̄ā·nāw way·yō·mer bin·ḵā ḇen- hă·ḏaḏ me·leḵ- ’ă·rām šə·lā·ḥa·nî ’ê·le·ḵā lê·mōr ha·’eḥ·yeh mê·ḥo·lî zeh
verses.literal: So Hazael went to meet Elisha taking with him a gift of forty camel loads . . . of every good thing from Damascus And he went in and stood before him and said Your son Ben-hadad king of Aram has sent me . . . to ask Will I recover from this illness
verses.literalPt: Foi, pois, Hazael a encontrar-se com ele, e tomou um presente na sua mão, a saber: de tudo o que de bom havia em Damasco, quarenta camelos carregados; e veio, e se pôs diante dele e disse: Teu filho Ben-Hadade, rei da Síria, me enviou a ti, a dizer: Sararei eu desta doença?

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָיו֙ אֱלִישָׁ֔ע לֵ֥ךְ אֱמָר־ לֹא חָיֹ֣ה תִחְיֶ֑ה וְהִרְאַ֥נִי יְהוָ֖ה כִּֽי־ מ֥וֹת יָמֽוּת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw ’ĕ·lî·šā‘ lêḵ ’ĕ·mār- lō ḥā·yōh ṯiḥ·yeh wə·hir·’a·nî Yah·weh kî- mō·wṯ yā·mūṯ
verses.literal: Elisha answered . . . Go and tell him . . . You will surely recover . . . But the LORD has shown me that in fact he will die . . .
verses.literalPt: E Eliseu lhe disse: Vai, e dize-lhe: Certamente viverás. Porém, o SENHOR me tem mostrado que certamente morrerá.

verses.original: וַיַּעֲמֵ֥ד אֶת־ פָּנָ֖יו וַיָּ֣שֶׂם עַד־ בֹּ֑שׁ וַיֵּ֖בְךְּ אִ֥ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·mêḏ ’eṯ- pā·nāw way·yā·śem ‘aḏ- bōš way·yê·ḇək ’îš hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: Elisha fixed his gaze steadily on him until Hazael became uncomfortable Then the man of God began to weep
verses.literalPt: E afirmou a sua vista, e fitou os olhos nele até se envergonhar; e o homem de Deus chorou.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר חֲזָאֵ֔ל מַדּ֖וּעַ אֲדֹנִ֣י בֹכֶ֑ה וַיֹּ֡אמֶר כִּֽי־ יָדַ֡עְתִּי אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁר־ תַּעֲשֶׂה֩ לִבְנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל רָעָ֗ה מִבְצְרֵיהֶ֞ם תְּשַׁלַּ֤ח בָּאֵשׁ֙ וּבַחֻֽרֵיהֶם֙ בַּחֶ֣רֶב תַּהֲרֹ֔ג וְעֹלְלֵיהֶ֣ם תְּרַטֵּ֔שׁ וְהָרֹתֵיהֶ֖ם תְּבַקֵּֽעַ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ḥă·zā·’êl mad·dū·a‘ ’ă·ḏō·nî ḇō·ḵeh way·yō·mer kî- yā·ḏa‘·tî ’êṯ ’ă·šer- ta·‘ă·śeh liḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl rā·‘āh miḇ·ṣə·rê·hem tə·šal·laḥ bā·’êš ū·ḇa·ḥu·rê·hem ba·ḥe·reḇ ta·hă·rōḡ wə·‘ō·lə·lê·hem tə·raṭ·ṭêš wə·hā·rō·ṯê·hem tə·ḇaq·qê·a‘
verses.literal: Why is my lord weeping asked Hazael Because I know - the evil you will do to the Israelites Elisha replied You will set fire to their fortresses kill their young men with the sword dash their little ones to pieces and rip open their pregnant women
verses.literalPt: Então disse Hazael: Por que chora o meu senhor? E ele disse: Porque sei o mal que hás de fazer aos filhos de Israel; porás fogo às suas fortalezas, e os seus jovens matarás à espada, e os seus meninos despedaçarás, e as suas mulheres grávidas fenderás.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר חֲזָהאֵ֔ל כִּ֣י מָ֤ה עַבְדְּךָ֙ הַכֶּ֔לֶב כִּ֣י יַעֲשֶׂ֔ה הַדָּבָ֥ר הַגָּד֖וֹל הַזֶּ֑ה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלִישָׁ֔ע הִרְאַ֧נִי יְהוָ֛ה אֹתְךָ֖ מֶ֥לֶךְ עַל־ אֲרָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ḥă·zā·h·’êl kî māh ‘aḇ·də·ḵā hak·ke·leḇ kî ya·‘ă·śeh had·dā·ḇār hag·gā·ḏō·wl haz·zeh way·yō·mer ’ĕ·lî·šā‘ hir·’a·nî Yah·weh ’ō·ṯə·ḵā me·leḵ ‘al- ’ă·rām
verses.literal: But how could your servant a mere dog do such a monstrous thing said Hazael And Elisha answered The LORD has shown me that you will be king over Aram
verses.literalPt: E disse Hazael: Pois, que é teu servo, que não é mais do que um cão, para fazer tão grande coisa? E disse Eliseu: O SENHOR me tem mostrado que tu hás de ser rei da Síria.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ׀ מֵאֵ֣ת אֱלִישָׁ֗ע וַיָּבֹא֙ אֶל־ אֲדֹנָ֔יו וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֔וֹ מָֽה־ אָמַ֥ר לְךָ֖ אֱלִישָׁ֑ע וַיֹּ֕אמֶר אָ֥מַר לִ֖י חָיֹ֥ה תִחְיֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·leḵ mê·’êṯ ’ĕ·lî·šā‘ way·yā·ḇō ’el- ’ă·ḏō·nāw way·yō·mer lōw māh- ’ā·mar lə·ḵā ’ĕ·lî·šā‘ way·yō·mer ’ā·mar lî ḥā·yōh ṯiḥ·yeh
verses.literal: So Hazael left Elisha and went to his master who asked him What did Elisha say to you And he replied He told me that you would surely recover . . .
verses.literalPt: Então partiu de Eliseu, e foi a seu senhor, o qual lhe disse: Que te disse Eliseu? E disse ele: Disse-me que certamente viverás.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י מִֽמָּחֳרָ֗ת וַיִּקַּ֤ח הַמַּכְבֵּר֙ וַיִּטְבֹּ֣ל בַּמַּ֔יִם וַיִּפְרֹ֥שׂ עַל־ פָּנָ֖יו וַיָּמֹ֑ת וַיִּמְלֹ֥ךְ חֲזָהאֵ֖ל תַּחְתָּֽיו׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·hî mim·mā·ḥo·rāṯ way·yiq·qaḥ ham·maḵ·bêr way·yiṭ·bōl bam·ma·yim way·yip̄·rōś ‘al- pā·nāw way·yā·mōṯ way·yim·lōḵ ḥă·zā·h·’êl taḥ·tāw
verses.literal: But the next day Hazael took a thick cloth dipped it in water and spread it over the king’s face So Ben-hadad died and Hazael reigned in his place
verses.literalPt: E sucedeu que no outro dia tomou um cobertor e o molhou na água, e o estendeu sobre o seu rosto, e morreu; e Hazael reinou em seu lugar.

verses.original: וּבִשְׁנַ֣ת חָמֵ֗שׁ לְיוֹרָ֤ם בֶּן־ אַחְאָב֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וִיהוֹשָׁפָ֖ט מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה מָלַ֛ךְ יְהוֹרָ֥ם בֶּן־ יְהוֹשָׁפָ֖ט מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇiš·naṯ ḥā·mêš lə·yō·w·rām ben- ’aḥ·’āḇ me·leḵ yiś·rā·’êl wî·hō·wō·šā·p̄āṭ me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh mā·laḵ yə·hō·w·rām ben- yə·hō·wō·šā·p̄āṭ me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: In the fifth year of the reign of Joram son of Ahab over Israel Jehoram son of Jehoshaphat succeeded his father . . . . . . . . . as king of Judah
verses.literalPt: E no ano quinto de Jorão, filho de Acabe, rei de Israel, reinando ainda Jeosafá em Judá, começou a reinar Jeorão, filho de Jeosafá, rei de Judá.

verses.original: בֶּן־ שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וּשְׁתַּ֛יִם שָׁנָ֖ה הָיָ֣ה בְמָלְכ֑וֹ וּשְׁמֹנֶ֣ה שָׁנָה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ben- šə·lō·šîm ū·šə·ta·yim šā·nāh hā·yāh ḇə·mā·lə·ḵōw ū·šə·mō·neh šå̄·nå̄h mā·laḵ bî·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: Jehoram was thirty-two . . . years old . . . when he became king and he reigned in Jerusalem eight years
verses.literalPt: Era ele da idade de trinta e dois anos quando começou a reinar, e oito anos reinou em Jerusalém.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֜לֶךְ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ׀ מַלְכֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשׂוּ֙ בֵּ֣ית אַחְאָ֔ב כִּ֚י בַּת־ אַחְאָ֔ב הָֽיְתָה־ לּ֖וֹ לְאִשָּׁ֑ה וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·leḵ bə·ḏe·reḵ mal·ḵê yiś·rā·’êl ka·’ă·šer ‘ā·śū bêṯ ’aḥ·’āḇ kî baṯ- ’aḥ·’āḇ hā·yə·ṯāh- lōw lə·’iš·šāh way·ya·‘aś hā·ra‘ bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: And Jehoram walked in the ways of the kings of Israel just as the house of Ahab had done For he married a daughter of Ahab and did evil in the sight of the LORD
verses.literalPt: E andou no caminho dos reis de Israel, como também fizeram os da casa de Acabe, porque tinha por mulher a filha de Acabe, e fez o que era mal aos olhos do SENHOR.

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־ אָבָ֤ה יְהוָה֙ לְהַשְׁחִ֣ית אֶת־ יְהוּדָ֔ה לְמַ֖עַן דָּוִ֣ד עַבְדּ֑וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר אָֽמַר־ ל֗וֹ לָתֵ֨ת ל֥וֹ נִ֛יר לְבָנָ֖יו כָּל־ הַיָּמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- ’ā·ḇāh Yah·weh lə·haš·ḥîṯ ’eṯ- yə·hū·ḏāh lə·ma·‘an dā·wiḏ ‘aḇ·dōw ka·’ă·šer ’ā·mar- lōw lā·ṯêṯ lōw nîr lə·ḇā·nāw kāl- hay·yā·mîm
verses.literal: Yet for the sake of His servant David the LORD was unwilling . . . to destroy Judah since He had promised to maintain a lamp for David and his descendants forever . . .
verses.literalPt: Porém o SENHOR não quis destruir a Judá por amor de Davi, seu servo, como lhe tinha falado que lhe daria, para sempre, uma lâmpada, a ele e a seus filhos.

verses.original: בְּיָמָיו֙ פָּשַׁ֣ע אֱד֔וֹם מִתַּ֖חַת יַד־ יְהוּדָ֑ה וַיַּמְלִ֥כוּ עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם מֶֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·yā·māw pā·ša‘ ’ĕ·ḏō·wm mit·ta·ḥaṯ yaḏ- yə·hū·ḏāh way·yam·li·ḵū ‘ă·lê·hem me·leḵ
verses.literal: In the days of Jehoram Edom rebelled against the hand of Judah and appointed their own king
verses.literalPt: Nos seus dias se rebelaram os edomitas, contra o mando de Judá, e puseram sobre si um rei.

verses.original: וַיַּעֲבֹ֤ר יוֹרָם֙ צָעִ֔ירָה וְכָל־ הָרֶ֖כֶב עִמּ֑וֹ וַֽיְהִי־ ה֞וּא קָ֣ם לַ֗יְלָה וַיַּכֶּ֨ה אֶת־ אֱד֜וֹם הַסֹּבֵ֤יב אֵלָיו֙ וְאֵת֙ שָׂרֵ֣י הָרֶ֔כֶב וַיָּ֥נָס הָעָ֖ם לְאֹהָלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·ḇōr yō·w·rām ṣā·‘î·rāh wə·ḵāl hā·re·ḵeḇ ‘im·mōw way·hî- hū qām lay·lāh way·yak·keh ’eṯ- ’ĕ·ḏō·wm has·sō·ḇêḇ ’ê·lāw wə·’êṯ śā·rê hā·re·ḵeḇ way·yā·nās hā·‘ām lə·’ō·hā·lāw
verses.literal: So Jehoram crossed over to Zair with . . . all his chariots When the Edomites surrounded him and his chariot commanders he rose up and attacked by night His troops, however fled to their homes
verses.literalPt: Por isso Jeorão passou a Zair, e todos os carros com ele; e ele se levantou de noite, e feriu os edomitas que estavam ao redor dele, e os capitães dos carros; e o povo foi para as suas tendas.

verses.original: וַיִּפְשַׁ֣ע אֱד֗וֹם מִתַּ֙חַת֙ יַד־ יְהוּדָ֔ה עַ֖ד הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה אָ֛ז תִּפְשַׁ֥ע לִבְנָ֖ה בָּעֵ֥ת הַהִֽיא׃
verses.transliteration: way·yip̄·ša‘ ’ĕ·ḏō·wm mit·ta·ḥaṯ yaḏ- yə·hū·ḏāh ‘aḏ hay·yō·wm haz·zeh ’āz tip̄·ša‘ liḇ·nāh bā·‘êṯ ha·hî
verses.literal: So to this day Edom has been in rebellion against the hand of Judah Likewise Libnah rebelled at the same time
verses.literalPt: Todavia os edomitas ficaram rebeldes, contra o mando de Judá, até ao dia de hoje; então, no mesmo tempo, Libna também se rebelou.

verses.original: וְיֶ֛תֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י יוֹרָ֖ם וְכָל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה הֲלֽוֹא־ הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־ סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ye·ṯer diḇ·rê yō·w·rām wə·ḵāl ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh hă·lō·w- hêm kə·ṯū·ḇîm ‘al- sê·p̄er diḇ·rê hay·yā·mîm lə·mal·ḵê yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: As for the rest of the acts of Jehoram along with all his accomplishments . . . are they not written in the book of the Chronicles . . . of the Kings of Judah
verses.literalPt: O mais dos atos de Jeorão, e tudo quanto fez, porventura não está escrito no livro das crônicas de Judá?

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֤ב יוֹרָם֙ עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֔יו וַיִּקָּבֵ֥ר עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֖יו בְּעִ֣יר דָּוִ֑ד וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ אֲחַזְיָ֥הוּ בְנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·kaḇ yō·w·rām ‘im- ’ă·ḇō·ṯāw way·yiq·qā·ḇêr ‘im- ’ă·ḇō·ṯāw bə·‘îr dā·wiḏ way·yim·lōḵ ’ă·ḥaz·yā·hū ḇə·nōw taḥ·tāw
verses.literal: And Jehoram rested with his fathers and was buried with them in the City of David And his son Ahaziah reigned in his place
verses.literalPt: E Jeorão dormiu com seus pais, e foi sepultado com seus pais na cidade de Davi; e Acazias, seu filho, reinou em seu lugar.

verses.original: בִּשְׁנַת֙ שְׁתֵּים־ עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֔ה לְיוֹרָ֥ם בֶּן־ אַחְאָ֖ב מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מָלַ֛ךְ אֲחַזְיָ֥הוּ בֶן־ יְהוֹרָ֖ם מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: biš·naṯ šə·têm- ‘eś·rêh šā·nāh lə·yō·w·rām ben- ’aḥ·’āḇ me·leḵ yiś·rā·’êl mā·laḵ ’ă·ḥaz·yā·hū ḇen- yə·hō·w·rām me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: In the twelfth . . . . . . year of the reign of Joram son of Ahab over Israel Ahaziah son of Jehoram became king . . . of Judah
verses.literalPt: No ano doze de Jorão, filho de Acabe, rei de Israel, começou a reinar Acazias, filho de Jeorão, rei de Judá.

verses.original: בֶּן־ עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וּשְׁתַּ֤יִם שָׁנָה֙ אֲחַזְיָ֣הוּ בְמָלְכ֔וֹ וְשָׁנָ֣ה אַחַ֔ת מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְשֵׁ֤ם אִמּוֹ֙ עֲתַלְיָ֔הוּ בַּת־ עָמְרִ֖י מֶ֥לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ben- ‘eś·rîm ū·šə·ta·yim šā·nāh ’ă·ḥaz·yā·hū ḇə·mā·lə·ḵōw wə·šā·nāh ’a·ḥaṯ mā·laḵ bî·rū·šā·lim wə·šêm ’im·mōw ‘ă·ṯal·yā·hū baṯ- ‘ā·mə·rî me·leḵ yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Ahaziah was twenty-two . . . years old . . . when he became king and he reigned in Jerusalem one year His mother’s name was Athaliah the granddaughter of Omri king of Israel
verses.literalPt: Era Acazias de vinte e dois anos de idade quando começou a reinar, e reinou um ano em Jerusalém; e era o nome de sua mãe Atalia, filha de Onri, rei de Israel.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֗לֶךְ בְּדֶ֙רֶךְ֙ בֵּ֣ית אַחְאָ֔ב וַיַּ֧עַשׂ הָרַ֛ע בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה כְּבֵ֣ית אַחְאָ֑ב כִּ֛י חֲתַ֥ן בֵּית־ אַחְאָ֖ב הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·leḵ bə·ḏe·reḵ bêṯ ’aḥ·’āḇ way·ya·‘aś hā·ra‘ bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh kə·ḇêṯ ’aḥ·’āḇ kî ḥă·ṯan bêṯ- ’aḥ·’āḇ hū
verses.literal: And Ahaziah walked in the ways of the house of Ahab and did evil in the sight of the LORD like the house of Ahab for he was a son-in-law of the house of Ahab
verses.literalPt: E andou no caminho da casa de Acabe, e fez o que era mal aos olhos do SENHOR, como a casa de Acabe, porque era genro da casa de Acabe.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֜לֶךְ אֶת־ יוֹרָ֣ם בֶּן־ אַחְאָ֗ב לַמִּלְחָמָ֛ה עִם־ חֲזָהאֵ֥ל מֶֽלֶךְ־ אֲרָ֖ם בְּרָמֹ֣ת גִּלְעָ֑ד וַיַּכּ֥וּ אֲרַמִּ֖ים אֶת־ יוֹרָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·leḵ ’eṯ- yō·w·rām ben- ’aḥ·’āḇ lam·mil·ḥā·māh ‘im- ḥă·zā·h·’êl me·leḵ- ’ă·rām bə·rā·mōṯ gil·‘āḏ way·yak·kū ’ă·ram·mîm ’eṯ- yō·w·rām
verses.literal: Then Ahaziah went with Joram son of Ahab to fight against Hazael king of Aram at Ramoth-gilead . . . and the Arameans wounded Joram
verses.literalPt: E foi com Jorão, filho de Acabe, a Ramote de Gileade, à peleja contra Hazael, rei da Síria; e os sírios feriram a Jorão.

verses.original: וַיָּשָׁב֩ יוֹרָ֨ם הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ לְהִתְרַפֵּ֣א בְיִזְרְעֶ֗אל מִן־ הַמַּכִּים֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יַכֻּ֤הוּ אֲרַמִּים֙ בָּֽרָמָ֔ה בְּהִלָּ֣חֲמ֔וֹ אֶת־ חֲזָהאֵ֖ל מֶ֣לֶךְ אֲרָ֑ם וַאֲחַזְיָ֨הוּ בֶן־ יְהוֹרָ֜ם מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֗ה יָרַ֡ד לִרְא֞וֹת אֶת־ יוֹרָ֧ם בֶּן־ אַחְאָ֛ב בְּיִזְרְעֶ֖אל כִּֽי־ חֹלֶ֥ה הֽוּא׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yā·šāḇ yō·w·rām ham·me·leḵ lə·hiṯ·rap·pê ḇə·yiz·rə·‘el min- ham·mak·kîm ’ă·šer yak·ku·hū ’ă·ram·mîm bā·rā·māh bə·hil·lā·ḥă·mōw ’eṯ- ḥă·zā·h·’êl me·leḵ ’ă·rām wa·’ă·ḥaz·yā·hū ḇen- yə·hō·w·rām me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh yā·raḏ lir·’ō·wṯ ’eṯ- yō·w·rām ben- ’aḥ·’āḇ bə·yiz·rə·‘el kî- ḥō·leh hū
verses.literal: So King Joram returned to Jezreel to recover from the wounds that the Arameans had inflicted on him at Ramah when he fought against Hazael king of Aram Then Ahaziah son of Jehoram king of Judah went down to Jezreel to visit Joram son of Ahab because Joram had been wounded
verses.literalPt: Então voltou o rei Jorão para se curar, em Jizreel, das feridas que os sírios lhe fizeram em Ramá, quando pelejou contra Hazael, rei da Síria; e desceu Acazias, filho de Jeorão, rei de Judá, para ver a Jorão, filho de Acabe, em Jizreel, porquanto estava doente.
